turns.content: draft me a cold outreach email to a list of CEOs. i want it short, like 3 sentences, no fluff, just a clear ask.

Subject: Quick question

Hi {{First Name}}, I’m reaching out because we help {{type of company}} achieve {{specific outcome}} without {{common pain}}.  
Would it be worth a 15-minute call to see if we could do the same for {{Company}}?  
If yes, I can send over a few times next week.
the ask is for a 20 minute intro call about our AI product.

Subject: 20-minute intro?

Hi {{First Name}}, we’ve built an AI product that helps {{target company/team}} {{specific benefit}}.  
I’d like to show you how it could apply to {{Company}} and see if there’s a fit.  
Are you open to a 20-minute intro call next week?
also it needs to build rapport. mention something personal about them that shows you actually researched them. and include a story about why our product matters.

Subject: Quick intro, {{First Name}}?

Hi {{First Name}}, I saw {{specific personal/relevant detail — e.g., your recent interview on scaling ops at Company / your post about AI adoption / the new market expansion}} and thought your point about {{specific theme}} was spot on.

also keep it 3 sentences. no exceptions.
